text: Ethics in AI is becoming a very important topic today. As artificial intelligence systems make more decisions in our lives, we must think about whether they are fair. One major problem is bias. If the data used to train AI is not balanced, the system may treat some groups unfairly. Fairness means that AI should give everyone equal chances. Privacy is also a serious concern, because AI often collects and uses personal information. People need to know how their data is used. Transparency helps here: companies should explain how their AI works. Finally, responsible AI development means engineers and governments must work together to create rules that protect people and support trust.
